The next London SynBio Network event will be on Thursday the 26th of February. As usual, we will have 2x20 mins talks, followed by networking over drinks and snacks:

🧬 PromoterAtlas: decoding regulatory sequences across Gammaproteobacteria using a transformer model
Lucas Coppens (Biofoundry | Imperial)

🌾 Resurrecting plant defence mechanisms to avoid crop pathogens
Imogen Binnian (Resurrect Bio | )

📍 Location and time: Thursday the 26th of February at 18:00, SHER 324 - Lecture Theatre, Imperial Sherfield Building, South Kensington, Imperial College London, South Kensington Campus, Sherfield Building (see this link to see how to get there). The event has step-free access and is open to anyone, but please register so reception has your details.

➡️ Register at: https://events.humanitix.com/london-synbio-network-14

🧬 London SynBio Network is organised by Early Career Researchers and hosts monthly meetups to bring Synbio folks from academia and industry together, providing an informal space to share ideas and ask for advice.
